subject: design/implement-now-e2e-tasks
statement: each perturbation is scoped to the task's own process tree — its own environment, its own clock and network view, its own generated load — never to the host. Workers run concurrently by default, so a host-wide perturbation would push sibling workers past their wall-clock budgets into spurious respawns, making one task's admission check another task's failure.
